message.text: There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is defined in `proto/api/v1` as protobuf services, served via Connect RPC and gRPC-Gateway (REST).

r05.
There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is Protocol Buffers in `proto/api/v1/` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, and the other `*_service.proto` files), served as Connect RPC and gRPC-Gateway/REST from `server/router/api/v1/` (`AGENTS.md`, `README.md`). Generated Go/OpenAPI live in `proto/gen/`; TypeScript clients in `web/src/types/proto/`.
